notes.title: Patch Notes - Achievement Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]We're happy that you're enjoying the achievements for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance. [/p][p]We've seen your reports for the patch and have quickly implemented some bug fixes: [/p][p][b]LIST OF CHANGES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Getting over 100 WPM on the same playthrough now grants both Red Things Go Faster and Faster than Lucius The Eternal achievements. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented High Gothic achievement from popping. [/p][/*][/list][p]Happy purging!  [/p]

notes.title: Words of Vengeance Post-Launch Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Space Marines!  [/p][p]A few weeks ago, we launched Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance during the Warhammer Skulls Showcase and since then, the response has been nothing short of phenomenal.  [/p][p]So many people have played the game, shared reviews, and some of you have also reported bugs that you’ve encountered while playing.  [/p][p]Well today, we’ve squashed some of those bugs to make Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance a smoother, more enjoyable experience. [/p][p] [/p][h2]Patch Notes [/h2][p]Please find the patch notes below:  [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash which would cause during the Sector Imperialis boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would open Steam VR.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which would cause unavoidable damage from a Blue Horror.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where typing would be disabled during the boss fight on Sector Imperialis.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which would cause the game menus to appear in unsupported languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with enemy spawning on slow frame rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies would be too close to player and made improvements on slow frame rates.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game credits.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated movement and events to cater to slower frame rates.[/p][/*][/list][p]If any of these bugs persist in your save, please send an email to marketing@aurochdigital.com with your PC specs and a description of when and where this is occurring so we can investigate it further![/p][p][/p][h2]Achievements[/h2][p]We also heard your request for achievements, and we’re excited to share that achievements will be coming to Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance in a future patch!  [/p][p]Stay tuned for more news on that soon. [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. [/p]

notes.title: A Patch is Incoming!
notes.notes:
We've been overwhelmed by the incredible reception for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance. We thought we were creating a fun little side project, and it quickly became so much more than that with over 100,000 players within the first week!  

Between all the positive feedback, we have also heard your requests for bug fixes!  

We’re pleased to let you know that we’re working on a patch focused on some of the recurring bugs we’ve seen reported by community members, but we need your help to identify the cause.  

If you’ve experienced the following issues, we would appreciate you sharing your computer specs, the levels you encountered them on, and what you were doing immediately before the bug was triggered:  

[list]
[*] The game not recognising your keyboard. 
[*] The game starts in another language. 
[*] Walking past enemies and soft locking the game. 
[/list]

This will really help our team to work out what’s causing them. Additionally, any video footage you can share of the incidents is super helpful! Please send your bug reports to marketing@aurochdigital.com!

If you’ve encountered other bugs that aren’t listed above, please email us about them too and we’ll look into them!  

Thank you again for all of your support with Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance. We’re so happy that you enjoyed it and let us know your high score!  

All the best, 

Auroch Digital Team
